overview: A dark, high-contrast web app where you upload your own documents and chat with them to get answers grounded in your files, with citations back to the exact passage.
features: Upload PDF, TXT, and Markdown documents
Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your documents
Inline citations that reveal the exact source passage
Document library with search, rename, and delete
Multi-turn chat history you can reopen later
Sign in to keep your documents and chats private to you
